Prove yourself as the best thief around with PVP, add to your haul with new levels, and kick it old school with skins inspired by the original [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/113020/Monaco_Whats_Yours_Is_Mine/"]Monaco: What’s Yours is Mine.[/url][/p][p][/p][p]In the new [b][i]Monaco 2[/i][/b] PVP mode, up to four players are on the job. Whoever collects 200 coins first gets off scot-free with the loot and bragging rights. You’ll want to case the joint before diving in, as each new PVP level has its own chaotic twist.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]The Cafe Shootout: [/b]The race is on in this arena as you’ll want to loot 200 coins before everyone else. Make your shots count with limited ammo, and when you hit your target, add some of their coins to your total.[/p][/*][*][p][b]The Hotel[/b]: Not only will you need to steal your way to 200 coins, you’ll have to do it without the civilians in the bustling hotel noticing your sticky fingers. Oh also, you can teleport.[/p][/*][*][p][b]The Graveyard[/b]: The danger level amps up in this level as guards lurk around the graveyard waiting to stop your gold grabbing antics. You’ll not only need to be faster than your opponents but also sneakier.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Let the Antics BEGIN![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1063030/Monaco_2/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Find eight new character skins that bring the feel of the original [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/113020/Monaco_Whats_Yours_Is_Mine/"]Monaco: What’s Yours is Mine[/url] to the sequel. Also, your voices have been heard! Pocketwatch Games implemented balance adjustments for late-game levels, which includes the Prison level that has caused even the most experienced thieves to falter.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Key Features:[/b][/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Thief on Thief Thievery: [/b]The new PVP mode brings 3 levels, and even more antics. Race against up to 3 other players to be the top thief while contending with limited ammo, no weapons, and pacing guards across three levels.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Assemble Your Crew: [/b]They say there’s no honor among thieves, but they’ve never met your crew! Team up with up to three other players in local or online multiplayer to finish the job.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Utilize Your Skills: [/b]Choose from a selection of eight playable characters, each with their own unique abilities and playstyles. Need to adapt? Switch your character mid-run to overcome whatever obstacles stand between you and untold riches![/p][/*][*][p][b]Hatch the Perfect Plan: [/b]Every heist requires careful planning. With Blueprint Mode, you can look at the level’s layout before you start the mission and craft the best approach.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Endless Thrills: [/b]Complete the structured campaign or test your skills against the hundreds of procedurally generated seeded levels, proving once and for all that you and your friends are the ultimate thieves![/p][/*][/list][p]
Wait no longer for this new level of thievery, as the new content can be experienced on all platforms now. Players can keep up to date on news from the criminal underworld of [b][i]Monaco 2[/i][/b] by following Pocketwatch Games on [u][url="https://x.com/PocketwatchG"]Twitter[/url][/u], [u][url="https://www.facebook.com/PocketwatchGames"]Facebook[/url][/u], [u][url="https://www.youtube.com/@pocketwatch/featured"]YouTube[/url][/u], and joining the [u][url="https://discord.com/invite/pocketwatch"]official Discord[/url][/u] today.[/p]

notes.title: Monaco 2 Out Now!
notes.content:
This highly anticipated sequel to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/113020/Monaco_Whats_Yours_Is_Mine/]Monaco: What’s Yours is Mine[/url] is the ultimate stealth-arcade game, playable solo, online or with up to 4 friends on the couch. Assemble a team of smooth criminals, plot out your approach, and take the city of Monaco for all its worth. Whether you execute with elegance or fumble your way to riches, no two heists are ever the same. 

[previewyoutube=vXEq4Bgj334;full][/previewyoutube]

Prepare the getaway car and tackle missions solo or with up to three friends as you master the unique skills and abilities of your band of thieves. Each wonderful wrongdoer brings their own personality to the team, from the quick dash of the Prowler to the distractingly delightful dog of the Socialite, there is always a way out of any tricky situation ahead. 

Take it slow or smash and grab your way to the loot in devilishly difficult procedurally generated levels. Can you and your crew keep it together long enough to finish the job and outsmart the system? In Monaco 2, you’re the boss calling the shots!

[b]Key Features:[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Assemble Your Crew:[/b] They say there’s no honor among thieves, but they’ve never met your crew! Team up with up to three other players in local or online multiplayer to finish the job.
[*] [b]Utilize Your Skills:[/b] Choose from a selection of eight playable characters, each with their own unique abilities and playstyles. Need to adapt? Switch your character mid-run to overcome whatever obstacles stand between you and untold riches!
[*] [b]Hatch the Perfect Plan:[/b] Every heist requires careful planning. With Blueprint Mode, you can look at the level’s layout before you start the mission and craft the best approach.
[*] [b]Endless Thrills:[/b] Complete the structured campaign or test your skills against the hundreds of procedurally generated seeded levels, proving once and for all that you and your friends are the ultimate thieves!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4458448/d736b177df8a3f44e0292e3994e7add87e6eba35.jpg[/img]

Don't forget, the invitational runs through April 14th, so work fast!! Finish the first four levels at super sonic speeds and post your run under the hashtag #Monaco2Invitational. Share your fastest runs on social media and tag Pocketwatch Games to get shoutouts from the developers! 

All videos will require a visible timer to authenticate run times and no cuts to the level video. Videos can be uploaded to YouTube or streamed live via Twitch and saved as a VOD.  Have any questions? Reach out to the Pocketwatch team via [url=https://x.com/PocketwatchG]X[/url] or the official Monaco 2 [url=https://discord.com/invite/pocketwatch]Discord[/url] server. 



Join [url=https://www.twitch.tv/pocketwatch]Pocketwatch Games on Twitch [/url]for launch day shenanigans and developer hot tips. Or maybe developer shenanigans and launch day hot tips. Regardless, we'll see you there!

notes.title: A Little Luck for the Perfect Score
notes.content:
Hello Crew!

Everyone knows we thieves can be a superstitious lot and our crew is no exception. Today, we’re diving into the Trinket system, a key feature that lets each thief carry unique charms to turn the tide of any heist.


[b]Trinkets[/b]

During your time in Monaco, you and your crew will work to unlock four trinket abilities per character. Each trinket provides additional power and specialization, but as with all good things in life, power isn’t free. Equipping these trinkets costs a bit of your base health, so choosing wisely is key. Let’s take a closer look into the trinket abilities of Jobbie, our favorite little robot sidekick!

Jobbie’s core ability is teleportation. He can zip through all visible areas including windows, over furniture, and even through prison cell doors to escape the job undetected. Additional trinket abilities for Jobbie include:

[list]
[*] [b]The GPU Array[/b]: Granting x4 teleporting speed.
[*] [b]The Cardboard Box[/b]: Causes you to appear invisible without taking damage.
[*] [b]The Worm[/b]: Infecting electronics with a deadly virus.
[*] [b]The Wifi Extender[/b]: Significantly increases your teleporting range, which is particularly useful when navigating through replayed levels. 
[/list]
These trinket abilities are just the beginning as each master thief has a ton of variation to fit different play styles and to suit the challenges of each level. It will be up to you and your crew to figure out which trinkets are best on every heist!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4458448/2a30178d5e5bc1da2e407a6ea519edeec728bbc3.png[/img]

[b]Diamonds are a Thief’s Best Friend[/b]

Trinkets can be unlocked by collecting diamonds earned from completing missions quickly, along with bonus objectives like gathering all of the coins and escaping a job undetected. Use your trinkets wisely in the Hard Truth (seed-locked campaign levels) as you can only earn one diamond per level. But the real source of diamonds comes when jumping into the Unreliable Narrator mode, where the levels are shuffled ensuring no two heists play out the same way. 


Get ready to experiment with a variety of trinkets as luck will have it when our upcoming co-op demo releases on February 20th ahead of Steam Next Fest. It's almost time to pocket your rewards in the city of Monaco!

notes.title: Monaco 2: Development Update!
notes.content:
Greeting Thieves!


It’s been a bit since you’ve heard from us (building a game is serious business), but we wanted to update you all on the development of Monaco 2. Rather than write a stuffy blog post, we thought we’d compile the biggest questions we’ve seen from the Monaco community and grill Pocketwatch Games CEO Andy Schatz for answers.


[b]When is Monaco 2 coming out?[/b]
It’s coming out in 2025! (That’s all you’re gonna get outta me.)


[b]How many players can play Monaco 2?[/b]
Up to 4 friends can play, either split screen or online. In online mode, you can also invite additional spectators. Spectators can even join mid-mission and then join in as thieves on your next heist.


[b]What if I want to play by myself? Can I do that?[/b]
Of course! Let’s be clear, Monaco 1 was better known for its co-op than the single player. With Monaco 2, loads of care has been taken to make sure the single-player experience is compelling in its own right.


[b]How many playable characters will there be?[/b]
There are 8 playable characters, but each has a number of trinkets that significantly change their gameplay.


[b]Why did you switch the art style?[/b]
Monaco 1 came out over a decade ago, we wanted to make a new Monaco for a new generation of players. Since heist movies often hinge on playing with verticality and creative solutions to problems, 3d levels felt necessary for that vision.


[b]Wait, is this game procedurally generated?[/b]
Yes and no. The levels are built in chunks, and then a procedural game director stitches them together intelligently. The main campaign uses locked seeds hand-selected by the development team, so there’s a single experience shared by all players. But you can go back and play the campaign on random seeds for additional rewards, and you can play the Daily Heists to compete against other thieves!


[b]Does it run on Steam Deck?[/b]
Sure does!


And that’s all from Andy (for now)! We’ll be providing more updates in the coming months and expect to see more Monaco 2 information in the new year! Don't forget to Wishlist!

Happy Holidays!
Pocketwatch Games


Also, ICYMI - here is the trailer from Future Games Show, Late Summer 2024

Pre-order on Steam ([i]10% off for Monaco owners[/i]), game launches on Sept 12:

We’re as excited as you to get the game out there… help us spread the word and make our launch community packed with players like you!

[h1]Other Questions:[/h1]

[b]Q: Do I get anything with the pre-order?[/b]

A: You mean, aside from the discount? We’re working on some stuff, but we don’t have anything set in stone and ready to announce. No promises, okay?

We didn’t want to destroy Blizzard too badly, so we decided to give them a little breathing room. Gotta look out for the little guy, ya know?

[b]Q: I’m so excited to play![/b]

A: Me too. Me too.

If you’ve got any more questions, drop by our [b]Discord[/b] channel (discord.gg/Pocketwatch) and chat with us!

notes.title: FREE UPDATE: Monaco's Final Chapter: Fin. and farewell!
notes.content:
And thus closes a chapter…

Today, on April 3rd, 2014, we’re turning the last page of Monaco by releasing a free update containing the 4th and final campaign of the game.  This campaign is brutally difficult (all eight levels are as hard as Identity) and it concludes the story of the Gentleman and his nefarious crew.

[url=http://i.imgur.com/eVdgyuk.jpg]It’s called Monaco: Fin.[/url]

Read more at the [url=www.pocketwatchgames.com]Pocketwatch Games Blog[/url]

notes.title: Perpetual Motion! (an ongoing competition)
notes.content:
Greetings all you theives of Monaco!

Starting [b][u]November 3rd[/u][/b], there will be an ongoing contest for Runners and Mappers to strut their stuff!  So whether you're new to the game, or have been with us since the beginning, it can be your time to shine!


[h1][b] - - - - - Here is an overview of what will be happening - - - - - [/b][/h1]

There will be three seperate categories where Single-Player Runners, Multi-Player Teams, and Map Makers will all have a chance to win some pretty cool prizes, including: Monaco T-Shirts, Copies of Monaco to give to friends, and even Steam Cash!

Each week, One or Two Community maps from the Workshop ([i]chosen semi-randomly[/i]) will be featured in game.  Solo Runners and Teams will have 7 days to get their best time on these featured maps, and submit either a screen shot or video of this run to be enterred into that week's contest ([i]more information provided on the forum about this[/i]).

At the end of every 4 week period, each featured map will then be enterred into the Mappers' Contest, in which the community will get the chance to vote for their favourite.  The map with the most votes will be declared the winner, and the creator will have a choice between several grand prizes!


[h1][u][b]Everyone is elligible for this competition[/b][/u], so tell your friends, and get ready to [b]WIN[/b]![/h1]


[h1]For more information:[/h1]
http://steamcommunity.com/app/113020/discussions/0/792924952651258815/

notes.title: Still A Steal: Monaco Gets Huge Free Halloween Update
notes.content:
Delightful co-op heister Monaco is getting in the holiday spirit… of Christmas, for Halloween. The Jim-approved wonder has stolen from the, I guess, someone to give bounteous gifts to the poor/you, resulting in an update that will knock your socks off (or your entire Halloween costume, if you’re going as gigantic sock). For one, there are zombies, because there are always zombies, but also the update’s added an entire mini-campaign titled Monaco Origins that’s rich with character-driven backstory. Details belooooooooooooooooow.

(more…)

notes.title: Monaco, now with more Blondes, Penguins and Zombies
notes.content:
Our HUGE FREE UPDATE went out this morning, which includes the Linux port, a whole new Mini-Campaign, and the incredibly fun Zombie Mode!

[h1]Linux[/h1]
The Linux port is, well, just that.  Play on Linux!  Yes, this means we will eventually make sure the game is playable on the Steam Box.

[h1]Monaco Origins[/h1]
The Mini-Campaign is called Monaco Origins, and it tells the backstories of our eight naughty thieves.  Each mission includes new features, such as key-doors, trophies, keys and cash that can be carried by NPCs, RPG Guards, and the new player class, the Blonde!

[h1]Zonaco: Your Flesh Is Mine[/h1]
Zombie mode converts the entire original game into a zombie wasteland, with Bloaters and Wretches hungry for your CERVEAU...

[img]http://i.imgur.com/R8A8h3d.png[/img]

notes.title: The Gun Patch: Broken Windows and a Rocket Launcher
notes.content:
To celebrate the Summer Sale I've added a new gear type and added a new functionality to all projectile weapons!

[b]RPG[/b]
By popular request, I've added a rocket launcher to the game.  Currently it's only available in the editor, but if we win our upcoming community vote as part of the Steam Summer Sale, we will add them to the campaign as well!  So get out there and help us win that vote!

[b]BROKEN WINDOWS[/b]
The guns are not particularly useful in the later game, largely because they make so much noise.  So I wanted to give them an additional secondary effect.  Bullets now break windows, allowing you to walk through them when broken.  Try out the shotgun in The Pickpocket's bank mission to do some real damage!  Or use the crossbow to break a window silently.  You can still hit guards through the windows as well.

notes.title: A Patch for the Sissies
notes.content:
Monaco starts out pretty easy, and then ramps up the difficulty pretty quickly.  And then it keeps ramping.  And ramping.  And ramping.

I just patched the game to make the later stages more accessible (not easier) to people that play more casually.  In particular:

*Missions in the Pickpocket's Story now require only 1 Clean Out instead of 2.

*Single Player allows you to use all available characters instead of triggering Game Over at 4 lives.

Monaco is hard.  And when you die, especially if you've put 20 or 30 mintues into a mission, it can be frustrating.  Hopefully these changes will help the more casual players without affecting how the more hardcore players play the game.

notes.title: Editor and OSX launch date: Wed July 3rd... Help beta test!
notes.content:
We're bundling up two major updates to Monaco, scheduled to be released this coming Wednesday (July 3rd).  There are still some issues we are trying to work through.  Please help us beta test!
 
On PC, this update includes the Steam Workshop-powered mission editor!
 
In order to test the Mac beta, you will have to have bought the game via Steam or Humble Bundle.  Follow instructions below to set the build to the beta branch.
 
[b]IMPORTANT![/b]  The PC version contains some updates to the save file format and location.  We are doing our best to make sure no one loses progress, and we're hoping you can help us test this update.
 
So...  Please backup your save data first.  You can find HighScores.bin (which contains your progress) in c:/program files/steam/userdata/[your user id #]/113020/  You may also have save data located in c:/program files/steam/steamapps/common/Monaco/SaveData
 
[b]Updating to beta branch[/b]
Right click on Monaco in your Steam library and click on Properties
Go to the Betas tab
[On Mac, type "gentleman" into the password box]
Change the dropdown box to Beta and click OK.
The game should then update and you can try it out. 
 
[b]Questions:[/b]
[list]
[*]Does the game carry over your progress? (you can always downgrade back to the non-beta if progress does not import correctly)
[*]If you are on OSX 10.6.x, does it work?  If not, please send along your RFE.log, located in users/[user]/Library/Application Support/Pocketwatch Games/Monaco.  You may need to unhide the Library folder, using these instructions: http://www.wikihow.com/Unhide-the-User-Library-Folder-on-a-Mac
[/list]

[b](major) Known issues on OSX:[/b]
[list]
[*]Sound volumes are off (guards are quiet, helicopter is inaudible)
[*]Rumble does not work with gamepads
[*]We believe there's a shader issue with 10.6.8 that we are trying to work through.  If anyone is available to help out with this issue, please let us know! (email support@pocketwatchgames.com)
[/list]

So... put your Mole hats on and get to digging!
